title.narrative: Life-saving assistance to acutely vulnerable populations and IDPs, addressing the CCCM, and Protection needs in Al Ma'afer, and Jabal Habashi districts in Taiz governorate

The intervention addresses critical gaps in site management, protection risks (including GBV, CP), and unsafe shelter conditions exacerbated by displacement Conflict or crisis.
